flaws.description: Swapped the hex color literals between the Eco Tourism line (originally blue '#1f77b4') and the Sustainable Agriculture line (originally orange '#ff7f0e'), so Eco Tourism now renders orange and Sustainable Agriculture renders blue.

Swapped the value arrays of the 'Green Education' and 'Aquatic Farming' series in the data dictionary, so each line now plots the other sector's values while labels, colors, markers, and plot order remain unchanged.
